Details.title: Details
Details.description:
The full claim-status payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this:

{"title":"Your claims","claims":[{"id":"clm-4471","claimNumber":"CLM-4471","type":"Collision","policyLabel":"Auto — 2022 Tesla Model 3","filedDate":"2026-07-28","amount":3200.00,"currency":"USD","status":"Review","statusLabel":"In review","updatedDate":"2026-08-05","nextActionText":"Upload the repair estimate","steps":[{"label":"Submitted","state":"done"},{"label":"Review","state":"current"},{"label":"Approved","state":"upcoming"},{"label":"Paid","state":"upcoming"}]},{"id":"clm-3120","claimNumber":"CLM-3120","type":"Water damage","policyLabel":"Homeowners — 14 Elm St","filedDate":"2026-06-10","amount":8750.00,"currency":"USD","status":"Paid","statusLabel":"Paid","updatedDate":"2026-07-02","steps":[{"label":"Submitted","state":"done"},{"label":"Review","state":"done"},{"label":"Approved","state":"done"},{"label":"Paid","state":"done"}]}],"submitText":"Ask about a claim"}

Rules:
- 'title' (string, optional): heading shown above the list. Defaults to 'Your claims'.
- 'claims' (array, REQUIRED, at least one object): each claim MUST have 'id' (string, unique, sent back if the customer taps it), 'claimNumber' (string, the human-readable claim reference), and 'status' (string; one of 'Submitted','Review','Approved','Paid','Denied' — drives the accent colour and which step is current). Optional per claim: 'type' (string, e.g. 'Collision','Water damage'), 'policyLabel' (string, the policy the claim is on), 'filedDate' (string, ISO yyyy-mm-dd), 'amount' (number, the claimed or paid amount), 'currency' (ISO code string, defaults to 'USD'), 'statusLabel' (string, a friendly label for the status pill; defaults to the status), 'updatedDate' (string, ISO yyyy-mm-dd of the last update), 'nextActionText' (string, one short line describing what the customer needs to do next), and 'steps' (array of { 'label' (string), 'state' (string; one of 'done','current','upcoming') } describing the progress tracker). If 'steps' is omitted the card derives a default Submitted → Review → Approved → Paid tracker from 'status'.
- 'submitText' (string, optional): label for the footer button that lets the customer ask about a claim; defaults to 'Ask about a claim'.

Never emit an empty 'claims' array. Use the customer's real claims from context; if none are known, say so rather than inventing claim numbers. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
